# lz4-java 1.8.0 source inclusion

lz4-java is the work of its upstream authors and contributors. Copyright remains with the copyright
holders named in each unchanged source file and in the retained legal texts. This directory does not
relabel upstream implementation as M3jdk21-original.

Upstream: git://github.com/lz4/lz4-java.git
Published sources jar: https://repo.maven.apache.org/maven2/org/lz4/lz4-java/1.8.0/lz4-java-1.8.0-sources.jar (SHA-1 7609c362f37f0c0bd3743bc1976df2daa28ad19e)
License as declared by the published pom: The Apache Software License, Version 2.0

The complete upstream license text is retained in `LICENSE` (fetched from the upstream tag; see UPSTREAM_LICENSE.json),
alongside this notice and `PROVENANCE.json`. Every file listed in `SOURCES_MANIFEST.tsv` retains its exact
upstream bytes and header. No build descriptor is generated: donor-superset status API_SURFACE_DIFFERS_MISSING_CLASSES (API_SURFACE_DIFFERS_MISSING_CLASSES vs the published jar (missing classes 22, differing members 0/0; diff lz4-java-1.8.0.base.tsv)).
